artifacts.summary: Eight-phase DISPATCH of the antitone kappa-collision slice as depth-0 cell equality: two new LadderChain assemblies (slack-exposing raise, register-raising deletion), the split's five records, the widened free-anchor raise, both antitone cell inclusions, and one exhaustive schema plus a bounded corollary carrying no upward hypothesis.

memory_candidates.content: Forward-slack accounting in the RaySummary ladder construction is a BUDGET, not merely a hypothesis family. Three facts compose: (1) a raise of z's region by d*l increases the slack amount by exactly d*l from NO hypothesis (hasForwardSlack_raise / hasForwardSlack_raise_of_zero, LadderChain.lean), (2) a deletion spends exactly l, so a raise-then-delete round trip at z is net zero, and (3) HasForwardSlack is only the UPPER direction of the two-sided anchor-clause collapse anchor_clause_of_first_region_start, so it is the currency of register LOWERING and a register RAISE is free in the direction that costs. Rule of thumb: a register move opposite to the countdown costs slack equal to the opposing displacement MINUS whatever the raise already in the same construction bought. Two consecutive tasks framed an antitone/anchor obstruction as 'needs a hypothesis family no landed schema carries' when part of it was payable from the raise already present. Corollary found while planning: a witnessing obligation at amount 0 is a THEOREM (mem_cellAt_ladder_iff plus hasForwardSlack_zero), which lets one schema with a truncated Nat-subtraction amount replace two schemas split on a bounded/deep case distinction.
